eligibility: Farmer families with cultivable land in their name; income-tax payers, government employees and certain professionals excluded; e-KYC mandatory.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three ₹2,000 instalments by direct benefit transfer.
documents: Aadhaar, land records, Aadhaar-linked bank account, mobile number.
application_process: Register on pmkisan.gov.in, at an e-Sevai/CSC centre or via the agriculture department; complete e-KYC.

eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers.
benefits: Crop insurance; farmer premium capped at 2% (kharif), 1.5% (rabi), 5% (commercial/horticulture).
documents: Aadhaar, land records or tenancy document, bank details, sowing certificate from VAO.
application_process: Enrol before the seasonal cut-off via bank, cooperative, e-Sevai centre or pmfby.gov.in; report localised loss within 72 hours.

eligibility: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, farmer SHGs/JLGs.
benefits: Short-term crop credit at concessional interest with subvention for prompt repayment.
documents: Aadhaar, land records, photo, bank KYC.
application_process: Apply at a commercial bank, regional rural bank or cooperative society.

benefits: Free soil test with crop-wise fertilizer recommendations.
application_process: Contact the block agriculture office or soil testing laboratory.

eligibility: Individual farmers, groups, FPOs and cooperatives with a water source.
benefits: Subsidy for standalone solar pumps and solarising grid pumps; shares fixed by the state each year.
documents: Aadhaar, land records, water-source proof, bank details.
application_process: Apply via the TN Agricultural Engineering Department or state portal when open.

eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18–40 with up to 2 hectares.
benefits: Pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60; farmer contribution matched by the Centre.
application_process: Enrol at a Common Service Centre.

eligibility: Farmers, FPOs and traders at e-NAM linked markets.
benefits: Online trading with transparent bidding and bank payment.
application_process: Register on enam.gov.in, the app, or at a linked regulated market.

eligibility: Farmers forming or joining organic clusters.
benefits: Support for organic inputs, training and PGS certification.

eligibility: All farmers; priority to small/marginal, women and SC/ST farmers.
benefits: Subsidy on farm machinery and support for custom hiring centres.
documents: Aadhaar, land records, bank details, caste certificate if applicable.
application_process: Apply via the Agricultural Engineering Department / agrimachinery.nic.in when open.

eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, agri-entrepreneurs and start-ups.
benefits: 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 crore for post-harvest infrastructure, plus credit guarantee.
application_process: Apply at agriinfra.dac.gov.in and choose a lending bank.

scheme_name: Micro Irrigation Subsidy (PMKSY – Per Drop More Crop)
eligibility: Farmers with a water source and land records; small/marginal certificate for the higher subsidy.
benefits: Subsidy on drip/sprinkler; in Tamil Nadu up to 100% for small/marginal and up to 75% for others within unit-cost limits.
documents: Aadhaar, land records, water-source proof, small/marginal certificate.
application_process: Apply at the block horticulture/agriculture office or online via TNHORTNET.

eligibility: Vegetable/fruit growers holding an Uzhavar Sandhai identity card.
benefits: Sell directly to consumers without middlemen; shop space and weighing facilities.
documents: Farmer ID card issued by Agricultural Marketing department.
application_process: Contact the Uzhavar Sandhai officer or district Agricultural Marketing office.
official_source: TN Agricultural Marketing & Agri Business Department

eligibility: Kuruvai paddy growers in areas notified for the year.
benefits: Input support (e.g. fertilizer, seeds) for Kuruvai paddy; extended to non-delta paddy farmers in 2026–27.
application_process: Register via the block agriculture office or Uzhavan app after announcement.

eligibility: Farmers with an agricultural service connection.
benefits: Free power supply for agricultural pump sets (continued in 2026–27 budget).
application_process: Apply at the local TNPDCL section office; connections follow registration seniority.

scheme_name: Paddy procurement at Direct Purchase Centres
benefits: MSP plus state incentive (KMS 2025–26: ₹1,560/tonne Grade A, ₹1,310/tonne common), paid to bank.
application_process: Register at the nearest DPC (online registration also available) and deliver on allotted date.

eligibility: Farmer members of the village cooperative credit society.
benefits: Short-term crop loans; about ₹17,000 crore planned for 2026–27; interest benefits for timely repayment (check with society).
application_process: Apply at the village Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Society.

benefits: Certified seeds of paddy, pulses, millets and oilseeds at subsidised rates; paddy seed subsidy continued from state funds in 2026–27.
application_process: Buy at the block Agriculture Extension Centre.
